The failure is unrelated to PR #35116 (which changes GPU plugin memory-dependency storage from hashMap to vector). A restart cannot fix this — the failure is deterministic.
recommended_actions: Identify which PR introduced the accuracy regression (first appeared 2026-07-27 ~12:33 UTC) by bisecting recent merged PRs
Inspect the PyTorch frontend GPTQ/INT4 dequantization path for numerical precision changes

prevention_strategies: Add a dedicated precommit accuracy test for GPTQ model exports that runs on every PR touching the PyTorch frontend or quantization code paths.
